shortDescription: Close to 50% of Lumen Technologies' $20 billion in debt is due in 2027. "CFO Journal: Inside Lumen's C-Suite — A CEO and CFO Who Clicked Immediately," at 5:55 a.m. ET, incorrectly said 10% of the debt it is due in 2027.
